clauses.title: CL-D103 records the one-file-per-record layout
clauses.section: ## CL-D103 — Every contract record is its own file; CONTRACT.md is the preamble and the record index
requires: The contract is the preamble followed by every listed file in index order, one blank line apart
A record is at most 8,000 bytes
the fix history of a change stays in its pull request's timeline and commits
Putting records back into one file, listing a record anywhere but the index, or giving the index a column the tests do not read requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: CL-D72 names the layout
clauses.section: ## CL-D72 — The focused validation is packaged and the alarm is reset for it
requires: CL-D103 later made `CONTRACT.md` the preamble and the record index

clauses.title: The tests assemble the contract from the index
The layout is pinned
requires: Issue #215 every record is one file under contract/, listed once in the index, in assembly order
Issue #215 CONTRACT.md is the preamble and the index, and the assembly is the contract
Issue #215 the record files are development records, outside the package payload
Issue #215 every record is at most 8,000 bytes, and the larger ones at the split stay within their ceiling
Issue #215 a change to one record puts that record, CONTRACT.md and README.md in the required evidence, and no other record
Issue #215 the index refuses any line but the note and record entries, and a record file must be a regular file

clauses.title: CL-D26 names the layout
clauses.section: ## CL-D26 — The authoritative contract record lives in this file
requires: CL-D103 later split it: the record is CONTRACT.md's preamble and index followed by the record files under `contract/`, all kept out of `files`.
